stem: A school-based clinician reviews a survey showing students can answer most HIV questions correctly but struggle with common STIs; what is the best educational follow-up?

options.text: Wait until students present with symptoms

explanation: Prioritise more STI-focused education. HIV knowledge is already high, but STI knowledge is poor, so the next teaching step should target the identified gap.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because the survey identifies a specific STI knowledge gap, so reducing education would not address the problem.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because relationship skills may be useful, but the main deficit described is in STI knowledge.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because HIV knowledge is high but STI knowledge is poor, so follow-up education should focus on STIs.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because the finding supports proactive education, not delaying until students become symptomatic.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because the key gap is infection knowledge, not only legal information.
